# Pass One — Architecture Possibilities

The Awtsmoos is beyond word and schema, yet a schema can faithfully carry a declared deed;
Awtsmoos.com should be a deterministic vessel where external intelligence supplies every semantic seed.

## Preferred model

`Agent/Program -> MovieDataEnvelope -> migrate -> validate -> normalize -> patch -> project -> render/export`

The movie maker never has an `English -> intent` arrow.

## Possible machine interfaces

- direct JavaScript object import,
- JSON text import parsed only as JSON syntax,
- file/drop import of canonical movie JSON,
- `postMessage` or CustomEvent carrying structured movie objects,
- globally callable API such as `loadMovie(movieData)` for external agents,
- explicit patch protocol for revisions,
- JSON Schema or equivalent machine-readable contract for agent tool generation,
- capability document so an agent knows what each renderer can project,
- validation result containing paths/codes rather than prose interpretation.

## Data vocabulary

Movie metadata, format, duration, scenes, cameras, layers, transforms, tracks, keyframes, transitions, assets, characters, dialogue/audio metadata, particles, charts, paths, text strings, 2D shapes, 3D world/mesh/light semantics, renderer hints, and extension metadata.

Text content inside a movie is allowed as literal display data. The engine must never infer behavior from that text.

## Rejected boundaries

- prompt textarea that creates scenes,
- feature regexes over prompt/subject,
- camera keyword grammar,
- internal provider `planMovie()` calls,
- internal provider `reviseMovie()` calls,
- prompt-derived local fallback generator,
- natural-language revision instructions.
